source.title: Behind the Ballroom Scores: Reconstructing Fan Voting and Designing Fairer Rules for DWTS

award_evidence.verification: downloaded official 1201-page results PDF; exact team row matched to submitted PDF header

claim: Rule-conditional fan-share inference supports parallel voting-rule audits and mixed-effects analysis, informing a targeted weekly rank-based protection rule.

manuscript_evidence.supports: Cleaning observed judge scores, eliminations and contestant metadata; latent fan support is a relative share, not observed vote totals.
Complementary feasible-set intervals and Plackett–Luce point inference with consistency and uncertainty diagnostics.
Same-week contestant-set counterfactuals for Rank, Percentage and Judges' Save, with cross-inference checks.
Mixed-effects models compare judge and inferred-fan outcomes with trait/season effects and pro/celebrity intercepts.
MARS-Soft+Disagreement modifies rank-sum risk only for judge-elite contestants with weaker fan rank; earlier/later season tuning/test split.
Inference sensitivity and season-blocked trait-model validation.

model_relationships.meaning: Same information for alternative weekly rules
Inferred fan signal joins traits and scores; point inputs
Judge-elite AND weaker fan rank; otherwise no bonus

references.borrowed: Source Figure1 on PDFphysicalp5 was visually inspected. Preserve shared inference -> two analysis branches -> revised rule, removing the source's ambiguous lateral branch.
references.not_borrowed: Source pixels, layout coordinates, paper-specific numerical results, team/award labels and unsupported causal claims.

caption: A mechanism-focused overview of ballroom voting. Observed weekly records constrain relative fan shares through feasible-set and likelihood approaches. The inferred shares support parallel matched-week rule comparisons and trait associations; observed judge outcomes remain separate. The enlarged MARS mechanism shows the elite/disagreement condition and its targeted rank-risk subtraction. All geometry and identities are schematic; no empirical result is reproduced.
placement: End of Introduction / Our Work, before assumptions. Intended 180mm full-text width; physical print proof pending.

review.execution_test: Completed full-image inspection of three real redesign/edit outputs; earlier versions retained, final selected for showcase.
checks: Replaced repeated colored panels with a feasible-share domain, matched-rule table and dominant conditional rank operation.
Final review: fan inference has no route to Judge outcome; observed-judge input is locally labeled.
Feasible-set bounds and complementary likelihood point share the inferred-output junction; no simplex-vertex input to likelihood.
MARS retains judge-elite AND worse-fan-rank conditions, positive-part gate, targeted subtraction and argmax elimination.
No empirical vote totals or performance claims; earlier/later season evaluation remains distinct.

issues.detail: Physical 180mm print/grayscale proof and independent acceptance remain pending. README uses a raster preview; mathematical label readability should be checked in the target manuscript.

source_notes: Physical PDF pages are used; printed main-paper pages are one less.
Fan-share uncertainty is not fully propagated in the source mixed-effects fit. No causal or measurement-error-adjusted interpretation is claimed.
Counterfactuals are weekly comparisons, not full-season replays. This is a known-source redesign, not a blind benchmark.
